title: Donidin's Advanced Combat
description: A mod that adds a combo system to Minecraft
body:
_Requires Cloth Config API_
# *Donidin's Advanced Combat*
## description
Minecraft combat usually feels like clicking a wall until it breaks. Donidin's Advanced Combat changes that. This mod is all about momentum—the better you fight, the more rewards you get, and the more chaotic the battlefield becomes.

### Instead of static damage, you now have a Combo Counter
Every hit builds your power (+0.5% damage per hit). At 40 hits, you’re dealing double damage. At 50, you hit the cap of 2.5x total damage. Don't stop. Keep the pressure on or watch your multiplier fade.

### Once you cross the 50-hit threshold, the mod stops being subtle
The screen tints red, vanilla music cuts out, and a custom heavy track (Music by GTDStudio (Palrom) — Hacker's Hideout Fight Theme) kicks in. You gain 15% damage resistance and a movement speed boost.

### Use Shift + Right-Click to trigger class-specific abilities
- Swords: A quick dash with i-frames. Perfect for dodging or closing the gap
- Axes: A 360° spin to clear everything around you
- Tridents: A piercing wave for long-range crowd control
- Maces: A massive uppercut that sends mobs into the stratosphere

### Everything is tweakable!
Don't like the red vignette? Turn it off. Is Berserk too easy to reach? Move the threshold to 100
